info.name: Voltix API - Full (module based)
info.description: One folder per module, in run order. Run 00 Setup first. Collection default auth = customerToken; folders override it. 09 Payments needs Stripe test keys + stripeWebhookSecret; 04 Media needs image.png + Cloudinary keys. Base path {{baseUrl}}/api/v1 (health and webhook are unprefixed).

exec: pm.test('201 customer, no password in body', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.user.role).to.eql('CUSTOMER'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b)).to.not.match(/password/i); });
pm.test('401 generic message', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'); });
pm.test('200 customer, no hash', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.role).to.eql('CUSTOMER'); pm.expect(b).to.not.have.property('passwordHash'); });

item.name: Refresh (401 reuse of the old token)

exec: pm.test('401 and the session family is revoked', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: Login as customer again (reuse killed the session)

exec: pm.test('200 and laptops exists', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const l = pm.response.json().find(c => c.slug === 'laptops'); pm.expect(l).to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('laptopCategoryId', l.id); });

pm.test('200 and dell exists', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d = pm.response.json().find(b => b.slug === 'dell'); pm.expect(d).to.exist; pm.collectionVariables.set('dellBrandId', d.id); });

pm.test('200, Apple only, price ascending', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items.every(i => i.brand.slug === 'apple')).to.be.true; const p = b.items.map(i => i.priceFromMinor); pm.expect(p).to.eql([...p].sort((a, c) => a - c)); });
pm.test('MacBook yes, Dell no', () => { const s = pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.slug); pm.expect(s).to.include('macbook-air-13-m3'); pm.expect(s).to.not.include('dell-xps-14'); });

pm.test('200 with specs and live availability', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.specs).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(b.variants[0].available).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(b).to.not.have.property('variantIds'); });
pm.test('400 with an errors list', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().errors).to.not.be.empty; });
pm.test('201, zero stock', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.priceMinor).to.eql(149900); pm.expect(b.available).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('200 renamed, price kept', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.name).to.include('updated'); pm.expect(b.priceMinor).to.eql(149900); });

pm.test('201, first image is primary', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.images).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(b.images[0].isPrimary).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.images[1].isPrimary).to.be.false; pm.expect(b.images[0].url).to.match(/^https:\/\//); });

item.name: Update product (add one image, remove one)

exec: pm.test('200, removed gone, kept present, 2 images', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const ids = pm.response.json().images.map(i => i.id); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('imageId2')); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('imageId')); pm.expect(ids).to.have.lengthOf(2); });

item.name: Create product (400 wrong file field, use images)

exec: pm.test('200, available = onHand - reserved', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.available).to.eql(b.onHand - b.reserved); pm.expect(b.onHand).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('201, on hand 10, not a replay', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.be.false; pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(10); pm.expect(b.movement.type).to.eql('STOCK_IN'); });

pm.test('200 replay, same movement, stock unchanged', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.movement.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('movementId')); pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(10); });
pm.test('201, on hand 8', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.movement.deltaOnHand).to.eql(-2); pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(8); });
pm.test('201, on hand 7', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.movement.type).to.eql('ADJUSTMENT'); pm.expect(b.stock.onHand).to.eql(7); });
pm.test('200, all at or below reorder level', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.every(i => i.available <= i.reorderLevel)).to.be.true; });

pm.test('3 movements newest first, ledger sums to 7', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items.map(m => m.type)).to.eql(['ADJUSTMENT', 'STOCK_OUT', 'STOCK_IN']); pm.expect(b.items.reduce((s, m) => s + m.deltaOnHand, 0)).to.eql(7); });

pm.test('200, 2 units, status OK, does not reserve', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.itemCount).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.items[0].status).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(b.subtotalMinor).to.eql(2 * 149900); });

pm.test('200, totals consistent, no issues', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.hasIssues).to.be.false; pm.expect(b.subtotalMinor).to.eql(b.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.lineTotalMinor, 0)); });

pm.test('201 pending order, totals add up', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const o = pm.response.json().order; pm.expect(pm.response.json().replayed).to.be.false; pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('PENDING_PAYMENT'); pm.expect(o.totalMinor).to.eql(o.subtotalMinor + o.shippingMinor); pm.expect(o.expiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.test('200 replay, same order', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.replayed).to.be.true; pm.expect(b.order.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });

exec: pm.test('409 pointing at the open order', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().orderId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });
pm.test('200, contains the pending order', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(o => o.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderId')); });
pm.test('200 with Stripe links, or 404 while not ready', () => {

pm.test('200 found with customer', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].customer.email).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('409 only paid orders', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Only paid orders'); });

pm.test('201 cancelled by customer, stock released', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(b.cancelReason).to.eql('CUSTOMER_CANCELLED'); pm.expect(b.expiresAt).to.be.null; });

pm.test('200, the order reservation was released', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const i = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(i).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(i[0].status).to.eql('RELEASED'); });

item.name: Prepare: checkout (cart still holds the item)

exec: pm.test('200, hosted url, 30+ min expiry', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.url).to.match(/^https:\/\/checkout\.stripe\.com\//); pm.expect(b.sessionId).to.match(/^cs_test_/); pm.expect(new Date(b.expiresAt).getTime()).to.be.above(Date.now() + 29 * 60 * 1000); });

const event = { id: 'evt_postman_' + Date.now(), object: 'event', type: 'checkout.session.expired', api_version: '2025-01-01', created: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000), livemode: false, pending_webhooks: 1, data: { object: { id: pm.collectionVariables.get('sessionId'), object: 'checkout.session', status: 'expired', metadata: {} } } };

item.name: Get order (cancelled by the expiry webhook)

exec: pm.test('200 CANCELLED / PAYMENT_EXPIRED', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(b.cancelReason).to.eql('PAYMENT_EXPIRED'); });

item.name: Manual: real card payment and refund (by hand, not in the Runner)
M2. Pay (open the URL from the console, card 4242 4242 4242 4242)
M3. Get order (expect PAID after the webhook)
M5. Admin: refund in full with restock

exec: pm.test('202 full refund accepted', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(202); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.stripeRefundId).to.match(/^re_/); pm.expect(b.full).to.be.true; });

item.name: M6. Get order (expect REFUNDED after the webhook)

exec: pm.test('200 counters', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.pending).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(b.failed).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('200, all FAILED (empty when the worker is healthy)', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.every(i => i.status === 'FAILED')).to.be.true; });
pm.test('409 for a published event', () => pm.expect([404, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code));

pm.test('200, the five jobs in order', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.jobs.map(j => j.name)).to.eql(['reservation-expiry', 'low-stock-alerts', 'stock-reconciliation', 'payment-reconciliation', 'cleanup']); pm.expect(b.healthy).to.be.a('boolean'); });

pm.test('200, current and previous period', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.currency).to.eql('EUR'); pm.expect(b.current.netRevenueMinor).to.eql(b.current.revenueMinor - b.current.refundsMinor); pm.expect(b.previous.orders).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('200, zero-filled daily points', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.points.length).to.be.within(30, 32); pm.expect(b.points[0]).to.have.keys('bucket', 'orders', 'revenueMinor', 'refundsMinor', 'unitsSold'); });

pm.test('200, 7 statuses, total is their sum', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.byStatus).to.have.lengthOf(7); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(b.byStatus.reduce((s, x) => s + x.count, 0)); });
pm.test('200, sorted by units desc', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const u = pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.unitsSold); pm.expect(u).to.eql([...u].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });

pm.test('200, shares add up to about 100 when there are sales', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.items.length) pm.expect(b.items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.sharePercent, 0)).to.be.within(99, 101); });
pm.test('200, newest first', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const t = pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.createdAt); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort().reverse()); });

pm.test('200 CSV with the expected header', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(pm.response.text().split('\r\n')[0]).to.eql('bucket,orders,revenueMinor,refundsMinor,unitsSold'); });

pm.test('200 CSV, no email addresses', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text().split('\r\n')[0]).to.eql('orderNumber,paidAt,status,subtotalMinor,shippingMinor,totalMinor,refundedMinor,units,currency'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('@'); });

pm.test('200, counts and stock value', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.keys('lowStockCount', 'outOfStockCount', 'totalStockValueMinor', 'totalUnitsOnHand', 'activeReservations', 'reservedUnits'); pm.expect(b.lowStockCount).to.be.at.least(b.outOfStockCount); });

pm.test('200, at or below reorder level, lowest first', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(items.every(i => i.available <= i.reorderLevel)).to.be.true; const a = items.map(i => i.available); pm.expect(a).to.eql([...a].sort((x, y) => x - y)); });
pm.test('200, newest first', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const t = pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.createdAt); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort().reverse()); });

pm.test('200, items and meta, no hashes', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items).to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b)).to.not.match(/password/i); });

pm.test('201 operator, no password in the body', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.role).to.eql('INVENTORY_OPERATOR'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b)).to.not.match(/password/i); });

pm.test('200, the user.create entry exists, no password stored', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(items.some(i => i.action === 'user.create')).to.be.true; pm.expect(JSON.stringify(items)).to.not.match(/password/i); });
